arabic: قُل لَّوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مَا تَلَوْتُهُۥ عَلَيْكُمْ وَلَآ أَدْرَىٰكُم بِهِۦ ۖ فَقَدْ لَبِثْتُ فِيكُمْ عُمُرًا مِّن قَبْلِهِۦٓ ۚ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
gloss: He (would) have made it known to you
sahihInternational: Say, "If Allāh had willed, I would not have recited it to you, nor would He have made it known to you, for I had remained among you a lifetime before it. Then will you not reason?"
yusufAli: Say: "If Allah had so willed, I should not have rehearsed it to you, nor would He have made it known to you. A whole life-time before this have I tarried amongst you: will ye not then understand?"
urdu: (یہ بھی) کہہ دو کہ اگر خدا چاہتا تو (نہ تو) میں ہی یہ (کتاب) تم کو پڑھ کر سناتا اور نہ وہی تمہیں اس سے واقف کرتا۔ میں اس سے پہلے تم میں ایک عمر رہا ہوں (اور کبھی ایک کلمہ بھی اس طرح کا نہیں کہا) بھلا تم سمجھتے نہیں

arabic: يَسْـَٔلُكَ ٱلنَّاسُ عَنِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ ۖ قُلْ إِنَّمَا عِلْمُهَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ تَكُونُ قَرِيبًا
sahihInternational: People ask you concerning the Hour. Say, "Knowledge of it is only with Allāh. And what may make you perceive? Perhaps the Hour is near."
yusufAli: Men ask thee concerning the Hour: Say, "The knowledge thereof is with Allah (alone)": and what will make thee understand?- perchance the Hour is nigh!
urdu: لوگ تم سے قیامت کی نسبت دریافت کرتے ہیں (کہ کب آئے گی) کہہ دو کہ اس کا علم خدا ہی کو ہے۔ اور تمہیں کیا معلوم ہے شاید قیامت قریب ہی آگئی ہو

arabic: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَٱلْمِيزَانَ ۗ وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ قَرِيبٌ
sahihInternational: It is Allāh who has sent down the Book in truth and [also] the balance [i.e., justice]. And what will make you perceive? Perhaps the Hour is near.
yusufAli: It is Allah Who has sent down the Book in Truth, and the Balance (by which to weigh conduct). And what will make thee realise that perhaps the Hour is close at hand?
urdu: خدا ہی تو ہے جس نے سچائی کے ساتھ کتاب نازل فرمائی اور (عدل وانصاف کی) ترازو۔ اور تم کو کیا معلوم شاید قیامت قریب ہی آ پہنچی ہو

sahihInternational: And what can make you know what is the Inevitable Reality?
yusufAli: And what will make thee realise what the Sure Reality is?
urdu: اور تم کو کیا معلوم ہے کہ سچ مچ ہونے والی کیا ہے؟

sahihInternational: And what can make you know what is Saqar?
yusufAli: And what will explain to thee what Hell-Fire is?
urdu: اور تم کیا سمجھے کہ سقر کیا ہے؟

sahihInternational: And what can make you know what is the Day of Judgement?
yusufAli: And what will explain to thee what is the Day of Sorting out?
urdu: اور تمہیں کیا خبر کہ فیصلے کا دن کیا ہے؟

sahihInternational: But what would make you perceive, [O Muḥammad], that perhaps he might be purified
yusufAli: But what could tell thee but that perchance he might grow (in spiritual understanding)?-
urdu: اور تم کو کیا خبر شاید وہ پاکیزگی حاصل کرتا

sahihInternational: And what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?
yusufAli: And what will explain to thee what the Day of Judgment is?
urdu: اور تمہیں کیا معلوم کہ جزا کا دن کیسا ہے؟

arabic: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
sahihInternational: Then, what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?
yusufAli: Again, what will explain to thee what the Day of Judgment is?
urdu: پھر تمہیں کیا معلوم کہ جزا کا دن کیسا ہے؟

sahihInternational: And what can make you know what is sijjeen?
yusufAli: And what will explain to thee what Sijjin is?
urdu: اور تم کیا جانتے ہوں کہ سجّین کیا چیز ہے؟

sahihInternational: And what can make you know what is ʿilliyyūn?
yusufAli: And what will explain to thee what 'Illiyun is?
urdu: اور تم کو کیا معلوم کہ علیین کیا چیز ہے؟

sahihInternational: And what can make you know what is the night comer?
yusufAli: And what will explain to thee what the Night-Visitant is?-
urdu: اور تم کو کیا معلوم کہ رات کے وقت آنے والا کیا ہے

sahihInternational: And what can make you know what is [breaking through] the difficult pass?
yusufAli: And what will explain to thee the path that is steep?-
urdu: اور تم کیا سمجھے کہ گھاٹی کیا ہے؟

sahihInternational: And what can make you know what is the Night of Decree?
yusufAli: And what will explain to thee what the night of power is?
urdu: اور تمہیں کیا معلوم کہ شب قدر کیا ہے؟

sahihInternational: And what can make you know what is the Striking Calamity?
yusufAli: And what will explain to thee what the (Day) of Noise and Clamour is?
urdu: اور تم کیا جانوں کھڑ کھڑانے والی کیا ہے؟

sahihInternational: And what can make you know what that is?
yusufAli: And what will explain to thee what this is?
urdu: اور تم کیا سمجھے کہ ہاویہ کیا چیز ہے؟

sahihInternational: And what can make you know what is the Crusher?
yusufAli: And what will explain to thee That which Breaks to Pieces?
urdu: اور تم کیا سمجھے حطمہ کیا ہے؟
